Details 
 The Tredwell Hat delivers a rugged yet refined Western aesthetic in a mid-profile silhouette. Crafted from an all-over wool-blend melange, this 6-panel ranch hat brings the perfect mix of warmth, texture, and structure. Its curved bill and adjustable snapback give it a comfortable, athletic feel, while the mixed embroidery and direct appliqué design add bold Southwestern detail.
 Fit : Mid Profile | Curved Bill | Adjustable Snapback
 Details : 6 Panel All Over Wool Blend Melange, Mixed Embroidery, Direct Appliqué
